headlines.title: Nicole ‘Snooki’ Polizzi reveals hysterectomy after cervical cancer diagnosis
headlines.description: An emotional Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi announced on Friday that she underwent a hysterectomy operation to treat Stage 1 cervical cancer, months after first disclosing her diagnosis.

headlines.title: Flesh-eating bacteria kills one person in Florida
headlines.description: The U.S. has seen its first deadly case of flesh-eating bacteria in Florida. The bacteria is more common in the summer and can be transmitted by raw or undercooked sea food or through wound exposure. NBC News’ Erika Edwards explains symptoms to watch for and how to protect yourself.

headlines.title: Fertility After 40: What You Need to Know
headlines.description: With more women becoming mothers after 40, Dr. Lucky Sekhon, a board-certified reproductive endocrinologist at RMA of New York, joins TODAY's Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to discuss the cultural shift and what you need to know about fertility, including associated costs and age-related risks.

headlines.title: Start August Right With This Fitness and Food Plan
headlines.description: As August approaches and summer winds down, it’s the perfect time to focus on rest and recovery in the final weeks of the season. TODAY fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour and nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer share a plan to do just that.

headlines.title: A Look at the Surprising Ways Summer Can Affect Your Body
headlines.description: Longer days, warmer weather and changes to daily routines can impact everything from your heart and brain to chronic health conditions and even how some medications work. Dr. Cedrek McFadden, board-certified surgeon, joins TODAY with everything you need to know.

headlines.title: The best KN95 masks to shop, according to experts
headlines.description: KN95 masks can offer the best protection against Covid, according to the CDC. We asked experts how to wear KN95 masks, plus the best brands to shop from.

headlines.title: Tested: The best, most effective teeth whitening strips
headlines.description: Editors tested the best teeth whitening strips of 2026, including Crest, Lumineux and Moon, to see which actually whiten teeth without sensitivity.

headlines.title: Walmart has back-to-school must-haves on sale for up to 55% off
headlines.description: Get ahead of the back-to-school rush — Walmart is offering up to 55% off backpacks, school supplies and more. Shop the best deals before they sell out.

headlines.title: Talking Shop (and travel essentials) with Brian Kelly, a.k.a. The Points Guy
headlines.description: The Points Guy Brian Kelly is the top travel expert. He shares his essentials for every trip, including how he keeps his toddlers entertained on long flights.

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: In his opening statement, the former top health official accused Sen. Rand Paul of having an “unhinged obsession” with him and wanting him put “behind bars.”

headlines.title: Have cyclospora outbreaks peaked yet? CDC reports over 18,000 possible cases nationwide
headlines.description: There are promising signs that illnesses linked to contaminated lettuce may be slowing in Michigan, the hot spot of the multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis in the U.S.

headlines.title: How the cyclospora lettuce outbreak sparked a massive consumer trust crisis
headlines.description: The cyclospora outbreak has people avoiding salads and burrito bowls. Now, for many Americans the question is whether any lettuce can be trusted.
